Name: Walk To Ginger Island
Author: stardewmoddingteen
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Come on, everyone loves the feeling of relaxing on Ginger Island! With this mod, you now can walk to Ginger Island from Stardew Valley! You can also bring your horse there![/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]After unzipping the mod, place the folder named 'Walk To Ginger Island' into your mods folder. Next, use CJB cheats to unlock all areas and give yourself all golden walnuts. Now you can start playing! [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Walking to Ginger Island is now possible. (Enter from path next to the Library.)[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- You can now bring your horse to Ginger Island.[/color]

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
The SMAPI mod and the Content Patcher mod are required for this mod.

[b][size=4]Disclaimer[/size][/b]
This mod has not been tested with other mods. While it should work fine on its own, using it alongside additional mods is at your own risk. Please backup your saves before using the mod if you are using additional mods. If you find that some mods are not functioning with this mod, please let me know through the 'post' section for this mod.

[size=4][b]Shoutouts[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A huge thank you to everyone playing with this mod! [/color]
